From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cardioapps.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pause on PoC while we reorganize

Hi Aisha,

Quick heads-up from my side: we had a leadership shuffle in Product here and I've been asked to hand off the evaluation to Samir (cc'd). Given the handover and a couple of conflicting priorities, our internal timeline is paused for now.

I still want to keep this moving — once Samir has ramped up we'll need a short MAP to re-prioritize and confirm the evaluation criteria. Can you share a condensed MAP template and a proposed 2–3 week kick-off cadence?

Apologies for the churn — we value the Redwood work so this is just an internal timing hiccup.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Product, CardioApps
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cardioapps.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@cardioapps.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pause on PoC while we reorganize

Thanks for the update, Lena — and hi Samir, great to e-meet you.

We can absolutely do a short MAP to re-establish milestones and success criteria. To make this fast and actionable, I propose:

- 30-minute kickoff (intro + align goals) the week of Jun 28
- 2-week focused eval sprint (sample data, 3 canonical prompts, perf & cost observations)
- Decision checkpoint: go/no-go + procurement next steps at the end of week 2

I've attached a condensed MAP template (CardioApps_MAP_v2.xlsx) and our evaluation checklist (redwood-eval-checklist.pdf). Can you confirm Samir's primary evaluation leads (data/infra, product, procurement)? Once we have names I will assign internal owners: Marcus for solution architecture and Vivek for exec alignment. Monica (cc'd) will coordinate scheduling and docs.

Proposed kickoff slots:
- Tue Jun 29 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Jun 30 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, tell me two windows that do.

Thanks — looking forward to a quick reset.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cardioapps.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cardioapps.com>

Subject: Re: Transfer of champion & MAP reset — CardioApps evaluation plan

Quick note from my side — to streamline the 2-week sprint, we recommend the following minimum commitments from CardioApps:

- One technical lead for data/infra (2–3 hours/week) to provide sample data access and answer KV/cache questions
- One product owner to validate prompts and acceptance criteria (1–2 hours/week)
- Procurement contact for licensing/contracting questions at the decision checkpoint

On Redwood's side: I'll own the test harness and perf runs; Aisha will manage cadence and exec touchpoints. If that matches your expectations we can lock the kickoff.

—Marcus

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP & kickoff confirmed — CardioApps (DEAL-3742)

Great — thanks for the quick confirmations, team.

Kickoff: Wed Jun 30 14:00–14:30 PT (calendar invite sent).

Attached: CardioApps_MAP_v2.xlsx (updated with owner column) and redwood-eval-checklist.pdf. Key scoping changes we captured:
- Scope trimmed to two priority flows (billing reconciliation + patient summary generation) vs the original five
- Success criteria: quality threshold (ROUGE-like proxy > 0.72 on target prompts), median latency < 400ms at 1k+-token rate, and unit-cost target for 3-month pilot
- Decision checkpoint: Jul 14 — go/no-go + contracting next steps

Action items assigned (owners in MAP):
- Samir: validate acceptance criteria + coordinate Priya for data extracts
- Priya: provide sanitized sample dataset and mapping document by Jul 6
- Marcus: deliver test harness and perf baseline by Jul 8
- Aisha: run the evaluation cadence and host the checkpoint on Jul 14

Procurement — any paperwork or NDA refresh needed ahead of the checkpoint, please advise and we'll loop legal.

Related links: drive folder and HubSpot record included.

Thanks — we aim to keep this lightweight and outcome-driven. If any of the owner assignments need adjusting, call out before EOD Mon Jul 5.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
